case.title: Dylan Borland on American Alchemy
case.note: Structure test on one interview. Each claim is proposed. The claimant is the person who spoke it. A named person is someone the words refer to. Nothing on this page is a verified finding.

claims.text: Dylan Borland was a 1N1 geospatial intelligence specialist for the United States Air Force.
